faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Income Tax Department TN and Puducherry for filling up Stenographer Gr.I positions on a deputation basis in Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Stenographer Gr.I?
faq.answer: There are a total of 146 vacancies available for the Stenographer Gr.I post under this recruitment notification released in September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is completely offline. Candidates must download the form and send it via proper channel to the designated address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the completed offline application form is 30-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches the office before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Stenographer Gr.I?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 56 years as per the official recruitment notification guidelines for deputation.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary at Level-6 as per the 7th Pay Commission in the pay matrix of Rs. 35400-112400.

faq.question: Q7. What is the essential qualification required?
faq.answer: Officers holding analogous posts on a regular basis in the parent cadre or department, or with ten years of regular service in Pay Level-4, are eligible.

faq.question: Q8. Where should I send the filled application form?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent through the proper channel to the Commissioner of Income Tax (Admn & TPS), O/o PCCIT, Tamil Nadu & Puducherry, Chennai.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for applying to this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification?
faq.answer: You can check the official website at www.tnincometax.gov.in to download the notification PDF and access application proforma details.
